mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline fails to predict positive 60-day returns in > 50% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST < 1000 and INDPRO < 100) fails to predict negative returns in > 50% of cases over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, elevated consumer spending (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars signals economic overheating and impending policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS > 450000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a supply-side contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline fails to predict positive 5-day returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 138,000 thousand signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO < 100 and PAYEMS < 138000) fails to predict negative returns in > 50% of cases over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 138,000 thousand signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 138000 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in > 50% of cases.
